questions.question: Which defect is most commonly associated with improper upsetting operations?

explanations.a: Buckling occurs when the length-to-diameter ratio is too large.
explanations.b: Folding usually occurs in rolling processes.
explanations.c: Barreling is a normal effect due to friction, not necessarily improper upsetting.
explanations.d: Hot tearing is associated with casting.

questions.question: Why is lubrication important in the extrusion process?

answers.a: To improve surface finish and reduce friction
answers.d: To change the composition of metal

explanations.a: Lubrication reduces friction, extrusion force, and improves surface quality.
explanations.b: Hardness is affected by deformation and heat treatment.
explanations.c: Lubrication does not control temperature directly.

questions.question: In upsetting, what happens if the height-to-diameter ratio exceeds the recommended limit?

answers.c: Buckling of the workpiece may occur

explanations.c: Excessive height leads to instability and buckling.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of hot extrusion over cold extrusion?

explanations.a: Cold extrusion generally provides better accuracy.
explanations.b: Hot extrusion reduces flow stress of the material.
explanations.c: Surface finish is usually better in cold extrusion.

questions.question: Why is upsetting commonly used in bolt and fastener manufacturing?

answers.b: It allows head formation by increasing cross-section
answers.d: It eliminates the need for machining threads

explanations.b: Bolt heads are formed by localized upsetting.
explanations.c: Hollow products are made by extrusion or piercing.
explanations.d: Threads still require rolling or cutting.
